definitions: having the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something
having considerable skill, proficiency, or intelligence

exampleSentences.english: he was able to read Greek at the age of eight
they would never be able to afford such a big house
exampleSentences.turkish: bu kadar büyük bir evi asla karşılayamazlar.

exampleSentences.english: the dancers were technically very able

definitions: possession of the means or skill to do something
talent, skill, or proficiency in a particular area

exampleSentences.english: the manager had lost his ability to motivate the players
exampleSentences.turkish: teknik direktör oyuncuları motive etme yeteneğini kaybetmişti

achieve.basicTranslation: çaba, beceri veya cesaretle (istenen bir hedefi veya sonucu) başarıyla gerçekleştirmek veya ulaşmak
definitions: successfully bring about or reach (a desired objective or result) by effort, skill, or courage

exampleSentences.english: he achieved his ambition to become a press photographer

abandon.basicTranslation: (birini) desteklemeyi veya bakmayı bırakmak; terk etmek
definitions: cease to support or look after (someone); desert
give up completely (a practice or a course of action)
allow oneself to indulge in (a desire or impulse)

exampleSentences.english: her natural mother had abandoned her at an early age
exampleSentences.turkish: öz annesi onu küçük yaşta terk etmişti

exampleSentences.english: he had clearly abandoned all pretence of trying to succeed
exampleSentences.turkish: Başarılı olmaya çalışıyormuş gibi yapmayı açıkça bırakmıştı.

exampleSentences.english: negotiations were abandoned and fighting intensified
exampleSentences.turkish: müzakereler terk edildi ve çatışmalar yoğunlaştı
